# Artificial Intelligence (AI) Use Declaration {.unnumbered}

In accordance with the IFN646 unit guidelines permitting the ethical and responsible use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), the project team declares the use of the following GenAI tools during the preparation of this report and its associated data analysis pipelines.

## Summary of GenAI Tools Used

| Project Section | GenAI Tool Used | Primary Purpose |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Overall Document** | Google Gemini 4 (Argon) | Document structuring, Quarto book formatting, and streamlining writing style and cohesion across chapters. |
| **Task 1** | Google Gemini 3.1 Pro | Assisting with code organisation/refinement and improving sentence phrasing and clarity. |
| **Task 3** | Microsoft Copilot (GPT-based assistant) | Assisting with code organisation for VCF and CRISPOR off-target data processing, and refining scientific writing style. |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Detailed Purpose and Extent of Use

### Overall Report Structure & Cohesion (Gemini 4 Argon)

-   **Purpose of Use:** Google Gemini 4 (Argon) was used at the document level to assist in structuring the Quarto book layout, harmonising formatting across individual team contributions, and streamlining the phrasing, transitions, grammar, and punctuation of the overarching report.
-   **Extent of Use:** The tool was used strictly as an editorial and structural assistant after the core content and analyses had been drafted independently by the team. No scientific claims, data interpretations, or experimental conclusions were generated by the model.

### Task 1 (Gemini 3.1 Pro & Gemini 4 Argon)

-   **Purpose of Use:** During Tasks 1, Gemini 3.1 Pro (alongside Gemini 4 Argon for structural editing) was used to:
    -   Assist with refactoring, organising, and documenting scripts and commands used in the data preprocessing and analysis workflows.
    -   Improve the clarity, academic tone, and conciseness of the written methodology and discussion drafts.
-   **Extent of Use:** All exploratory data analysis, statistical modelling, parameter selection, and biological interpretations in Tasks 1 were conceptualized and executed independently by the team prior to using GenAI for code clean-up or text polishing.

### Task 3 (Microsoft Copilot)

-   **Purpose of Use:** Microsoft Copilot was used to support the preparation of Task 3 by:
    -   Assisting with the organisation and refinement of code used to process VCF files and off-target prediction data.
    -   Improving the clarity, grammar, structure, and scientific writing style of the report sections.
-   **Extent of Use:** Microsoft Copilot was not used to generate the experimental results, perform the biological analysis, conduct data interpretation independently, or draw conclusions without verification. All genomic analyses were performed using project datasets and independently reviewed by the team.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Validation and Evaluation of Outputs

Because GenAI tools can produce inaccurate, hallucinated, or suboptimal outputs, all AI-assisted code and text underwent strict verification before inclusion in the project:

1.  **Code and Pipeline Verification:**
    -   In **Task 1**, any refactored code or syntax suggestions generated by Gemini 3.1 Pro were executed locally against the project datasets and validated using deterministic sanity checks (e.g., comparing summary statistics, array dimensions, and output plots before and after code refactoring to confirm identical analytical results).
    -   In **Task 3**, code refinement suggestions from Microsoft Copilot were tested manually using CRISPOR off-target data and VCF files, and all intermediate and final outputs were cross-checked against expected pipeline outputs.
2.  **Scientific and Biological Verification:**
    -   All biological and biomedical interpretations across Tasks 1, 2, and 3 were independently verified against IFN646 lecture materials, peer-reviewed literature, and the empirical outputs produced by our analysis pipelines.
3.  **Editorial Review:**
    -   All phrasing, structural adjustments, and text revisions suggested by Gemini 4 (Argon), Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Microsoft Copilot were critically reviewed and manually edited by the team to ensure technical precision, factual accuracy, and alignment with our actual experimental findings.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Author Responsibility Statement

The team accepts full responsibility for the accuracy, integrity, and originality of the work submitted. All analyses, code implementations, results, interpretations, and conclusions presented in this report reflect the team’s own understanding of the project data and were independently verified prior to submission.

*This declaration is provided in accordance with the assessment requirements regarding the ethical and responsible use of Generative Artificial Intelligence.*
